HOUSEKEEPING NOTES

✓ DUPLICATES CLEARED (Sep 5). Removed the redundant Ninja Gaiden zip (NES, kept the verified [!] dump), a duplicate TMNT: Shredder's Revenge launcher stub, and the NBA Street Vol. 2 .zip (PS2, kept the loose EU/US .iso). The Parasite Eve Disc 1 "(1)" file turned out to be a different, larger dump rather than a copy — kept the original your .m3u points to and removed the stray.

✓ PS2 COMPRESSED TO CHD (Sep 5). All 9 PlayStation 2 games converted from raw ISO to CHD — each verified before its original was removed. The folder went from 44 GB down to 30 GB, reclaiming ~14.5 GB. NetherSX2 reads CHD natively, so nothing changes at play time.

✓ WII + GAMECUBE COMPRESSED TO RVZ (Sep 5). All 9 GameCube and 11 Wii games converted from ISO to RVZ, each verified complete (via header check). Dolphin on the Nova reads RVZ natively. Between this and PS2, the whole card dropped from 142 GB to 100 GB — about 42 GB reclaimed.

✓ COLLECTION REFRESHED (Sep 6). Added recent pickups — 8 NES (including the Metroid: Rogue Dawn hack), 8 SNES (Final Fantasy VI, Super Mario RPG, Mega Man X2, the Super Star Wars trilogy, and more), Metroid II + II DX (GB), Circle of the Moon + Zero Mission (GBA), Luigi's Mansion (GC), and Sonic CD on the new Sega CD shelf.

Also on the card, not counted as games: 25 Android apps and 10 emulator installs (RetroArch, Dolphin, DuckStation, NetherSX2, melonDS, and friends). The Neo Geo folder correctly includes its required neogeo.zip BIOS.

✓ BOX ART + RELEASE YEARS (updated Sep 6). Cover art and release year are now embedded for 601 of 602 games — including the recent pickups and the full CPS & Neo Geo arcade sets, freshly scraped. Only one title (the GBA Zelda: A Link to the Past & Four Swords) still lacks scraped art. The full library shows every game together, covers first. Filter with the CONSOLE, COLLECTION (franchise), and GENRE dropdowns — they stack, so you can do “SNES + RPG” or “Castlevania, newest first.” The VIEW button flips between a covers gallery and a flat list, and each SORT button (A–Z, rating, release date, console, collection, genre) flips direction when tapped again — sorting by console, collection, genre, or release date drops in section headings. A CLEAR button appears whenever a filter is active.

Ratings are a critic-consensus feel for each game on a 10 scale, colored green (8+), amber (6–7.9), pink (below 6). Tap any title for a one-line description.

Cataloged from /Volumes/RetroidROMs/ROMs · systems with only a systeminfo.txt were skipped · multi-disc games count once · arcade entries show the ROM-set shortname MAME/FBNeo expects
Hotkey mappings follow the RetroGame Corps RetroArch Starter Guide
